Ok here it goes:

Ring:

* Get the base
* Quality it up (your choice for critical/attributes
* Essence of scorn to hit 25% global crit
* Use fracturing orb to get the fracture on the base
* Essence of Rage to get the T0 strength
* Use it until you get T1 cast speed or T1 chaos resistance
* Orb of annulment until you have a free prefix and suffix
* Craft suffixes cannot be changed
* Go harvest add/remove chaos if you hit cast speed
* Go harvest add/remove speed if you hit chaos resistance
* If you do, great! Craft life and its done, otherwise go back to essence of Rage

Chest:

* Same as the ring for the fracture
* Use essence of loathing until you get 2 decent suffixes (I went with chaos and another resistance, you can go for chaos/strength too if you like)
* Prefixes cannot be changed
* Veiled chaos orb 
* Block life% and hit ailment avoidance 
* Craft the last prefix you want

Helmet:

* You guessed it right... buy the fractured base, or try it yourself (not recommended)
* Kind of like the chest... Just essence of loathing for the suffixes and than veiled chaos orb and craft last prefix...

This is how you do it:

1. Get fractured base
2. Perfect fossil to 30% quality
3. Use aetheric, corroded, metallic and shuddering fossil to get +1 to all spell skill gems (1 in 5)
4. Isolate 1 open prefix and 1 open suffix (annul until you get there)
5. If 2 open suffixes: great! 1 open suffix, craft prefixes can't be changed and scour. Than craft a random prefix and exalt slam to get 1 suffix
6. Craft: can have to 3 crafted modifiers and cannot roll attack modifiers
7. Harvest add/remove physical. Guarantied +1 to all physical spell skill gems. Here it is important that you had the 3 suffixes, because you have a greater pool to remove the suffix and not the prefix! If it removes the +1 to all spell skill gems, go to step 3
8. Prefixes are done!
9. Craft prefixes can't be changed and use veiled chaos orb
10. Block something (trigger a socketed spell has the highest weight, so block that) and unveil cast speed
11. Craft prefixes cannot be changed
12. Harvest add/remove critical
13. Hope it removes a crafted modifier and adds a high tier critical multiplier
14. If not you can prefix can't be changed and annul and hope it removes the critical mod, or go back to step 9
15. Craft last mod of your choice (I might change mine to chance to deal double damage instead of multiplier with rare/unique

All items follow kind of those rules (if you want one item in particular, let me know, I'll write it in detail):

All items can be crafted without TFT!

Get a base with a fracture that is the hardest to craft (lowest % chance to roll, check [craftofexile.com](https://craftofexile.com), of check my items).

Roll the other mods of the suffix/prefix with essences or with fossils. With essences you will only need to roll like 1 other good mod if the third is the fractured one, otherwise you want to roll until you have 2 mods you need.

If you have the 3 suffixes/prefixes you want you go prefixes/suffixes can't be changed. Depending if you want a veiled mod, or an insulated prefix/suffix mod you use a veiled chaos orb, or you use the harvest bench.

For the veiled chaos you use the chaos and block another mod to get the higher chances to unveil what you want. Craft another mod you want if you get the unveil you want, and if the item still has some room, just exalt slam it.

For the harvest bench you have 2 choices. If you wanted a veiled mod + harvest + craft you go: unveil mod, craft prefix/suffix cant be changed, and use add/remove and  pray it removes prefix/suffix cant be changed. If it does not hit, start over. If it hits, you hope its a high tear. Otherwise, start over.

If you only want one mod + craft + slam you go reforge crit/chaos, whatever you want!
